messages.subject: logProb is -Inf
parts:
Hi All,

I want to use the spatial stick breaking to do  the clustering, so I wrote the attached code, and I used the bisqure kernel, which has the attached formula for the weight:

In the attached code, I obtained this error message: 
warning: problem initializing stochastic node latent[1]: logProb is -Inf.

Please advise in this regard.

Thanks

messages.author: 7878556d408ec9ec
messages.subject: Re: logProb is -Inf
parts:
Hi Suzy,

The warning message here came from your choice of initial values for latent ~ dcat(pi). Given other initial values, the value of pi is (0, 0, 0, 1) for each i but your initial value for latent is 1. If you use 4 as the initial value for latent, the code will run fine without that warning. Hope it helps. 

Best wishes,
Wei

messages.author: 7878556d408ec9ec
messages.subject: Re: logProb is -Inf
parts:
Hi Suzy,

I am not familiar with the model you're using and may not be able to provide useful suggestions. From a quick glance, it seems that pi's value (stays at (0,0,0,1)) does not change when mcmc runs and thus latent is always 4. pi's parent nodes (stochastic, V, knot, and r) did update. So it might be worth looking into the model code for calculating pi, and see why they always produce the same value for pi if this is not expected. 

Best wishes,
Wei
